sn56.54:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yatthimā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti seyyathīdaṃ
sn56.54:1.2: Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī tam udakam parikkhayam pariyādānam gaccheyya ṭhapetvā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni || || 3.
sn56.54:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaram yaṃ vā sambhejja udakam parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnam yāni vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī ti || ||
sn56.54:1.5: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ sambhejja udakaṃ yad idam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhāni
sn56.54:1.6: saṅkham pi na upenti upanidham pi na upenti kalabhāgam pi na upenti sambhejja udakam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam upanidhāya dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī ti || || 4--5.
sn56.54:1.7: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || la ||
